Email addresses to CC on the invite.

actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom authenticated request to any SignNow API endpoint.

actions.upload_document.description: Uploads a document to your SignNow account. Supports PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, and more.
actions.upload_document.props.check_fiel: Enable if your document contains simple text tags that should be converted to fillable fields.
actions.upload_document.props.file.descr: The file to upload. Accepted formats: .pdf, .doc, .docx, .odt, .rtf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .bmp, .xml, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, .ps, .eps. Maximum size: 50 MB.
actions.upload_document_and_extract_fiel: Uploads a document and automatically converts text tags into SignNow fillable fields.

The file to upload. Text tags in the document (e.g. {{t:s;r:y;o:"Signer 1";}}) will be converted to fillable fields. Accepted formats: .pdf, .doc, .docx, .odt, .rtf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .bmp, .xml, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, .ps, .eps. Maximum size: 50 MB.
